_about: Draft companion of docs/research/VOXEL_WORLD_REPORT.md, answers B4.1 to B4.3 and section 4.8. Synthetic ids only (the test bundle of tools/fake_gen1/synth.py); nothing here comes from a ROM and no pack ships with the mod. 'manifest' is what a pack maker writes at assets/kantobridge/kb_pack/<name>.json inside an ordinary resource pack. 'keys_index' is what the client writes to <gameDir>/kantobridge/keys/<game>.json so pack makers can see every valid key; a real one is ROM-derived and stays on the player's machine.

_rules.keys: tile:<atlas>/<tile>[@<PALETTE>], sprite:<SPRITE_ID>, cell:<atlas>/<t0>-<t1>-<t2>-<t3>, struct:<atlas>/<16 hex signature>, place:<MAP_ID>/<n>, class:<name>, map:<MAP_ID>. The game is not part of a key; targets.games names the games a manifest applies to.
_rules.precedence: generated base < manifests in resource-pack order (later packs win) ; for one face or shape: place > struct / cell > tile@palette > tile > class > base.
_rules.validation: an entry that fails (unknown key, missing or badly sized texture, bad .vox, out-of-range rule, model over the quad budget) is skipped with a counted warning and the base is used; a pack can never leave a hole.
_rules.vox: first model of the file; voxelsPerBlock 8, 16 or 32; at most 256 voxels per axis; palette index 0 is empty; our mapping: vox z -> up, vox x -> east, vox y -> north (check with the calibration model of the template export).
_rules.textures: block faces must lie under textures/block/, be square, a power of two and at least 16 px; an art-set segment (here 'red') is part of every generated texture path from milestone M14 on.
